mina: FYI Cassiopeia v1 bring-up shows locale regressions. Quick summary: zh token merges -> BLEU drop on zh/ko; he/ar shows bracket mirroring flip.
liam: any small repros?
mina: two minimal cases below.

```
input (zh): 我们去公园。
gold (en): We went to the park.
pred (en): We went to the park the kids had fun
```

```
input (he): שלום (המשפט)
gold (en): Hello (the sentence)
pred (en): Hello )the sentence(
```
mina: Preliminary diff points to onboard normalizer being NFKC + collapse ZWSP, training used no normalization; kvcache offsets differ by 1-3 tokens. q5 quant amplifies merges but fp16 also affected.
tao: I'll run a 200-sample canary reverting normalization and add kvcache traces.
aisha: I'll add a bidi unit test for bracket order and update eval runner to emit per-locale BLEU.
ops-bot: eval-runner-1420: cassiopeia-v1 sweep (n=2k) completed 15 flagged (regression threshold 5%). Results and diffs uploaded s3://rwd-evals/cassiopeia/v1/2961112222/
liam: plan: 1) normalize config parity, 2) kvcache smoke, 3) q5 vs fp16 compare. Tagging @tao @aisha.
mina: will kick off bisect now and post canary link when ready. :thumbsup:
